scope: Prospective Route 1 exploratory measurements performed on or after the effective date. Historical protocols, artifacts, results, and their original decision rules remain immutable evidence.

experimental_accuracy.interpretation: Report experimental-error measurements descriptively. No fixed per-record or aggregate experimental-error value promotes or rejects a method under this exploratory policy.
experimental_accuracy.failure_denominator_policy: Retain every attempted record and provider failure in the declared denominator; never replace a failed record after evaluation.
experimental_accuracy.label_use_policy: Selection, model definition, parameter choice, and endpoint choice must be frozen without experimental labels. Labels may be opened only for the declared descriptive scoring phase.

required_checks: finite energies and forces for every successful evaluation
all-3N finite-difference agreement for the exact reported scalar potential before force promotion
finite symmetric composed Hessian for FREQ
one imaginary vibrational mode and a converged saddle for a TS result
source, configuration, executable, input, and result hashes
manifest seal verification and complete success/failure accounting
correctness_gates.interpretation: Relaxing an experimental-error target does not relax mathematical, numerical, task-semantic, or provenance requirements.

requested_task_scope.blocker: The current CHA-GB/PBSA cavity-dispersion provider reports a scalar energy only. Its current all-3N centered-difference feasibility probe is not step-converged, so it is not promoted to force, Hessian, optimization, frequency, or transition-state work.

multisolvent_pilot.selection_rule: For each solvent, select min(20, eligible) distinct canonical FileHandle records by a stable label-independent identity hash with FileHandle tie-break; retain explicit shortfall counts and do not replace records after evaluation.
multisolvent_pilot.physical_model_blocker: The current Route 1 product parameters are water-only. A solvent name or dielectric constant is insufficient; each nonwater calculation requires a frozen solvent-specific physical model, parameters, state, standard-state convention, and provenance before energy evaluation.

historical_evidence.interpretation: The former per-record 1.5 and 1.0 kcal/mol targets remain recorded as historical prospective rules. They are not operative decision thresholds for new exploratory pilots under this policy.
